levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبيد الله بن أبي مليكة

notes: the claimants («بني صهيب») and Marwan are in the scene and are left out
«قالوا ابن عمر» and «فدعاه فشهد» describe Ibn Umar's testimony as an act in the story, not his transmission (rule 6): left out; the chain ends at Ibn Abi Mulayka, who narrates the scene
